headline: Closed a deploy a no-op could cancel, a Desk refusal caused by the verifier, and a gate that failed on other repos' sessions; added held-run and model-servability observability.

items.title: Held Pages runs no longer cancel confirmed promotions
items.insight: refresh-live-data dispatched pages-deploy with no inputs and cancelled a confirmed promotion. Only runs that can deploy may now cancel in-flight runs.
items.evidence: S354 run 34824034218 cancelled by 34824092060; pages-deploy.yml concurrency expression

items.title: Publishers staging graph sources push with --resync
items.insight: Three publishers could push stale derived artifacts after a rebase. Fixed and gated.
items.evidence: check-publisher-resync 11/11 with negative controls; live 9/9 compliant

items.title: Gates stop failing on other repos' sessions
items.insight: Presence --check now verifies the payload against its own sources; code or registry drift still fails.
items.evidence: self-test 11/11; old payload failed; regenerated payload passes

items.title: Desk verifier escaped differently from the renderer
items.insight: A quoted fact rendered correctly and read as absent, refusing an edition. One shared escape function now.

items.title: Held publishers are visible
items.insight: Runs that concluded success but held are reported by name, advisory only.

items.title: A dead Desk model cannot hide behind its standby
items.insight: One completion per declared model with no failover, as a doctor advisory.

items.title: Mobile audit cannot silently measure production
items.insight: Local env files set BASE_URL to production; the audit now refuses that host without an explicit opt-in.
items.evidence: playwright --list refuses / lists / lists across the three cases

followUps: Mount the narrative on /journal/ with its own receipts.
Enable staging Worker observability after a cost check.
blockers: Edge sampler still waiting on studio-ops.
